ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: 9M Apr 2026 and FY2026 are not the same kind of period, so a percentage change between them would compare part of a year with a whole one

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 2e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 522.49 against price over EPS 345.00) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the two P/E routes disagree (market cap over net profit 522.49 against price over EPS 345.00) and the filing does not settle which row is right. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2026, the newest annual earnings on file, not on 9M Apr 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised; the balance-sheet multiples stand on FY2025
